lede: ChicChoi is an online shop for cute stationery and school bags, run by CHICCHOI LIMITED and shipping from China. Here's what it sells, what buyers say, and who it suits.

parts: ChicChoi is a real shop with a Shopify checkout, published policies and contact details. Its best sellers score 4.8 to 5 out of 5 on its own store, from 12 to 69 reviews each, but we found no Trustpilot page to compare. Orders ship from China and take one to three weeks to the US, and a change-of-mind return costs you postage plus a 10% restocking fee.

Drawstring backpacks and bags, pencil cases, planners and planner inserts, loose-leaf notebooks, travel journals, calendars, gel pens, stamps, washi stickers and other journaling supplies, many with its own illustrated designs. When we checked, its best sellers cost from $7.90 for a set of gel pens to $42.90 for the DOT DOT backpack.
Its About page says it's run by a team of women who love planning and journaling, with the motto "Cute Stationery Motivates".
